_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-23: the military family ("like 10 missionboard missions for Military Dungeons"), "we have droppods, those would be cool", and 13:35 "don't limit ourselves by what's there already in my mod, we can add the markers needed later"
_note: THE MILITARY FAMILY, 2 OF ~10: DEMOLITION. The case of charges is outside where the last team dropped it; three
weapons crates inside take a charge each, in any order; coming back out, the occupiers' reinforcements land in
pods at the door. The verb is SET, not take: the first of the family where nothing leaves with you.
Written to the delve marker set (outside entrance, centre, item markers 01 and 02), so the lint pool is EMPTY on
military sites until he adds the markers (missionboard06a's note says why).
No line describes an explosion: none is placed. The charges are set; what happens after is the client's.
Pay: med on the last fight (capped at med).

place._theme: Military sites; the family's marker set.

prose.name: Sabotage: Weapons Cache on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The occupiers of the <Place> are sitting on a weapons cache. A demolition team went in and didn't come out. Their charges are still at the entrance.
prose.card: Local Contract. Set charges on the weapons cache at the <Place> on <Planet>. Charges are at the entrance. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Collect the demolition charges at the <Place>
beats.journal: I found the last team's charges by the way in. Now I need to set them on the cache inside.
beats.name: Demolition Case

message.title: Demolition Case
message.text: Shut, and a little scorched on one corner. Three charges in foam, and a fourth slot that is empty.

beats.objective: Set charges on the weapons cache
beats.journal: One charge set on a crate of rifles, packed still in their grease.
beats.name: Weapons Crate

beats.journal: One charge set on a crate of grenades. Somebody had stencilled the count on the lid and then crossed it out twice.
beats.name: Munitions Crate

beats.journal: One charge set on a crate with no markings at all, and the lid nailed down twice as hard as the others.
beats.name: Unmarked Crate

beats._at: Back at the way in: open sky for the pods.
beats.journal: Three charges set on the cache at the <Place>. Their reinforcements came down in pods at the entrance as I came out, and I got clear anyway. The rest is the client's.
say: You're out. Get some distance, the cache is ours to deal with now.

broadcast: Our team's charges should be right at the entrance. Three crates inside, one charge each. And they'll hear you working. Expect company on the way out.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Voice 'Royce', australian, unused so far; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
